item.title: @elonmusk: Mona, a member of the Federation of the Blind, gave amazing testimony yesterday about@Tesla’s Cyberc...
item.description: Mona, a member of the Federation of the Blind, gave amazing testimony yesterday about@Tesla’s Cybercab after sitting in it this week: "To have something like the Cybercab would be very beneficial to us as the blind community; It’s got Braille in there. Nobody else has Braille. This would be so beneficial. The app is wonderful. There’s space to put the wheelchair. They can just push themselves right in. A lot of times, the Uber and Lyft if they see you with a dog or cane, they drive right past you. With Cybercab, it doesn't know that you're blind. It doesn't know that you're in a wheelchair. It just knows that you need a ride, so I completely love the car. Just sitting in it, how comfortable it is, just knowing something is accessible - it’s the most amazing thing out there." (via the Nevada Transportation Authority's general session meeting yesterday)

item.description: 🚨Joe Rogan says Twitter was a “censorship dystopian hellhole” before Elon Musk bought it. “Twitter being purchased was giant.” “Before that, you could get silenced, so you self-censored.” “A sports broadcaster got fired for saying ‘All Lives Matter.’” “There was active U.S. government involvement in Twitter. It was dark.” “Before Elon purchased it, it was a censorship dystopian hellhole, where if you said ‘a man is never a woman,’ like Megan Murphy did, you’re banned for life.”
